predictions.prediction_text: Banks’ reserves will fall when investors buy 4-, 8-, 13- and 17-week bills, pushing money-market rates up toward the Fed’s target, but if demand slackens dealers will absorb bills and monetize them via RRP/repo stabilizing yields.
